- Customers receive their own data and public notes.
- Tenant admins receive risk scores and internal notes.
- Unauthorized/cross-tenant access returns 404; support access returns 403.
- Added deterministic account/note ordering.

I did not run `scripts/dev-bootstrap.sh`; it requests external fixture registration and hook installation.
